mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at the current time is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% but the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% per annum signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% but the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates an economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: The joint condition of INDPRO falling and UNRATE rising occurs but the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an overheating economy that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, UNRATE falls but the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential construction (HOUST) indicates robust consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1400 (thousands of units) but the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 305.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 305.0 but the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer and industrial demand.
failure_condition: The joint condition of RSAFS falling and INDPRO falling occurs but the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a cooling housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST falls but the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
